
 Usage: agentos routines [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Work that runs by itself: runs, flows, schedules, workflows and brains.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ runs       Runs: list, show, cancel, decide.                                 │
│ flows      Saved flows: list, show, save, run, remove; and flows as files in │
│            git: pull, diff, push, validate, test.                            │
│ schedules  Cron schedules and webhook triggers.                              │
│ watches    Page watches that start a flow when a page changes.               │
│ workflows  Workflows: a trigger, then steps. Apply, run, retry, see what     │
│            happened.                                                         │
│ connector  Connectors: sites as typed operations, compiled into flows.       │
│ site-api   Site APIs: a site you can use, as a typed API of your own.        │
│ brains     Brains: run your agent on the node with your own subscription.    │
│ pilot      The pilot: a cheap worker that drives one lane toward one goal    │
│            (lane_do).                                                        │
│ plugins    Plugins: the workers this node can run, and who does their jobs.  │
│ agenda     The agenda: planned actions per workspace, their approval and     │
│            proof.                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
